plugins.name: grow-product-manager
plugins.description: AI assistant for Product Managers: research, concepts, brainstorming, requirements, task creation, data analysis, CJM research with funnel anomaly detection, hypothesis generation, knowledge library, multilingual artifact templates, planning suite (roadmap, project, quarterly, sprint), experiment lifecycle tracking (experiment-tracker), decision log, feedback triage, focus-advisor (daily/tactical/strategic PM focus briefs + live Focus Board from calendar/mail/meetings/Jira/roadmap/goals signals with ritual cadence and skill chaining), plugin release automation (release-manager), and design-bridge (brand-themed decks, prototypes, handoffs, research enrichment, WCAG 2.1 AA a11y gates + routing host that delegates hi-fi screen generation to an external design toolkit declared in local-context.md — bring your own Design System and design toolkit) — integrated with Jira, Confluence, Figma, and Tableau. Includes Product Reporter for Jira-based operational reports (sprint plan/review, quarter review, initiative status, member review) plus goal reports (3T5F), and a People-contour (goal-setter, one-on-one, performance-review, hiring-designer, offboarding-guide, delegation-coach) with vault-local person profiles. — v2.0.0 (released 2026-07-14)
